description: This file provides logging functions for the TestLink application, including logging audit events, warnings, localization warnings, general events, and timing utilities for performance measurement.

methods.name: logAuditEvent
methods.description: Logs an audit event with message, event code, object ID, object type, and source.

methods.name: logWarningEvent
methods.description: Logs a warning event with message, activity code, object ID, and object type.

methods.name: logL18NWarningEvent
methods.description: Logs a localization warning event with message, activity code, object ID, and object type.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs an event object containing message, log level, source, object ID, object type, and code.

methods.name: tLog
methods.description: Logs a message at a specified level, with optional source, object ID, object type, and activity code. Checks logger and transaction status before logging.

methods.name: tlTimingStart
methods.description: Starts a timing measurement with an optional name.

methods.name: tlTimingStop
methods.description: Stops a timing measurement with an optional name.

methods.name: tlTimingCurrent
methods.description: Returns the current elapsed time for a given timer name.
